==Rewards==

===Casual rewards===
Playing a casual game yields no rewards. 

===Competitive rewards===

In competitive games, players are given a certain amount of points based on their performance in a game, provided they have killed at least one player:{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/remaining-getting-around-changes?oldschool=1|title=Remaining Getting Around Changes|newsdate=1 April 2026}}<!--{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1292926674762440707|date=10 August 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102028|archivedate=27 October 2020}}-->
* 1st place - 6 points
* 2nd place - 5 points
* 3rd/4th place - 4 points
* 5th-9th place - 3 points
* 10th-19th place - 1 point

* Bonus Points (do not stack with each other):
** 3 kills - 2 point
** 5 kills - 3 points

'''Note:''' 

These points can be exchanged for reward items at [[Justine]]'s reward shop, [[Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing]]. Each point is worth up to {{coins|{{Max|{{GEP|Swift blade|1/350}}|{{GEP|Trouver parchment|1/30}}|{{GEP|Wilderness crabs teleport}}|{{GEP|Blighted entangle sack|70}}|{{GEP|Blighted teleport spell sack|50}}|{{GEP|Blighted vengeance sack|50}}|{{GEP|Blighted ancient ice sack|30}}|{{GEP|Adamant arrow|350}}|{{GEP|Bolt rack|200}}|{{GEP|Rune arrow|300/3}}|{{GEP|Dragonstone bolts (e)|20/3}}|{{GEP|Blighted karambwan|12}}|{{GEP|Blighted manta ray|15}}|{{GEP|Blighted anglerfish|15}}|{{GEP|Blighted super restore(4)|4}}|{{GEP|Climbing boots|20}}|{{GEP|Ring of wealth scroll|1/5}}|{{GEP|Magic shortbow scroll|1/5}}|{{GEP|Clue box|1/5}}|{{GEP|Crystal weapon seed|1/12}}|{{GEP|Granite clamp|1/25}}|{{GEP|Ornate maul handle|1/15}}|{{GEP|Steam staff upgrade kit|1/13}}|{{GEP|Lava staff upgrade kit|1/13}}|{{GEP|Dragon pickaxe upgrade kit|1/14}}|{{GEP|Ward upgrade kit|1/20}}|{{GEP|Green dark bow paint|1/25}}|{{GEP|Yellow dark bow paint|1/25}}|{{GEP|White dark bow paint|1/25}}|{{GEP|Blue dark bow paint|1/25}}|{{GEP|Volcanic whip mix|1/25}}|{{GEP|Frozen whip mix|1/25}}|{{GEP|Rune pouch note|1/75}}|{{GEP|Saradomin's tear|1/150}}|{{GEP|Target teleport scroll|1/250}}|{{GEP|Paddewwa teleport (tablet)|2}}|{{GEP|Senntisten teleport (tablet)|2}}|{{GEP|Annakarl teleport (tablet)|2}}|{{GEP|Carrallanger teleport (tablet)|2}}|{{GEP|Dareeyak teleport (tablet)|2}}|{{GEP|Ghorrock teleport (tablet)|2}}|{{GEP|Kharyrll teleport (tablet)|2}}|{{GEP|Lassar teleport (tablet)|2}}}} round 0}}. Tradeable rewards can only be purchased if the player has won at least 1 game.

===High stakes rewards===
For high stakes games, the sole survivor of the match will win 7,500,000 coins and the runner-up is awarded 2,500,000 coins, which is put into a [[reward chest (Last Man Standing)|chest]] near [[Justine]] where it may be claimed anytime by the player. For players in third to fifth place, they will have their next high stakes game free of charge.

Since a minimum of 24 players are needed to enter the game, 12,000,000 coins are put into the match. 10,000,000 of that are redistributed to the first two players and three players get free access to their next game, removing 1,500,000 coins that are put into a single match, meaning that Last Man Standing acts as a money sink with a minimum of 500,000 coins leaving the game per high stakes match.
